summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests intismeran autogene (V940) given with BCG, compared with BCG alone, in people with high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. In the combination group, intismeran autogene is given as a 1 mg intramuscular injection every 3 weeks for 9 doses, and TICE BCG 50 mg is put into the bladder once weekly for 6 weeks, then once weekly in weeks 13-15, 25-27, 49-51, and 73-75. The study aims to learn whether people live longer and without the cancer growing, spreading, or coming back.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba intismeran autogene (V940) administrado junto con BCG, en comparación con BCG solo, en personas con cáncer de vejiga no músculo-invasivo de alto riesgo. En el grupo de combinación, intismeran autogene se administra como inyección intramuscular de 1 mg cada 3 semanas por 9 dosis, y BCG TICE de 50 mg se instila en la vejiga una vez por semana durante 6 semanas, y luego una vez por semana en las semanas 13-15, 25-27, 49-51 y 73-75. El estudio busca saber si las personas viven más tiempo y sin que el cáncer crezca, se extienda o regrese.
who_for: Has high-risk bladder cancer confined to the inner lining, including Ta, T1, and/or carcinoma in situ (Cohort A)
Has carcinoma in situ with or without papillary tumors and is ineligible for or refuses IVESIC therapy (Cohort B)
Has not had BCG, or had BCG more than 2 years before high-risk recurrence (Cohort A)
Most recent TURBT was within 12 weeks before randomization, with confirmed high-risk histology
not_for: Has locally advanced (T2-T4) or metastatic urothelial cancer
Received systemic anticancer therapy, including investigational agents, within 4 weeks before randomization
Had a heart attack within 6 months of randomization, or has immunodeficiency or chronic systemic steroid use
Has current active tuberculosis or known HIV infection (Cohort A)
